name: Kita Dunmore
role: one of the Banked (Blood Hunter 2, Pale Moon; Crow at level 3)
backstory: Quenched from Frenzy on day 3, Kita has a knack for watching watchers: she spotted the Choir's runner boy and Rook's tail, and led the tail into the alley where Cassmund took him. She carried the Coal into the Cinder Hills without feeling its heat and stays at Dunmarrow with Gwenis.
wants: To prove she's more than the one who gets spotted.
secrets: She knows the Dunmarrow vault holds the Coal.

relationships.name: Gwenis Dunmore
relationships.how: fellow Banked; with her at Dunmarrow

relationships.name: Cassmund Furrow
relationships.how: her partner in taking Rook's tail
